definition: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012, a competition to estimate the content of photographs for the purpose of retrieval and automatic annotation using a subset of the large hand-labeled ImageNet dataset (10,000,000 labeled images depicting 10,000+ object categories) as training.
